units: <cite ref="Yoma 46a:4">Yoma 46ᵃ</cite> <he>מָשְׁלָה בהן האור</he> the flames had attacked them.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 75b:12">B. Mets. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שאשתו מוֹשֶׁלֶת עליו</he> he whom his wife rules.
<cite ref="Chullin 60b:3">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>לכי ומְשׁוֹלִי ביום וכ׳</he> (not <he>ומשול</he>; Rashi <he>לך ומְשׁוֹל</he>) go thou and attend by day and by night.—
B. Bath. 78ᵇ (ref. to Num. XXI, 27) המוֹשְׁלִים ביצרם who control their inclinations; a. e.—מוֹשֵׁל governor, consul.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:8">Yad. IV, 8</cite> <he>אתם כותבים את המושל וכ׳</he> you write the governor’s name and year together with the name of Moses in a document. [<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a:5">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מוֹשְׁלֵי</he>, <he>מוֹשְׁלִים</he>, censorial emendations for <cite ref="M01579"><he>מַלְכוּת</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes.]

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:7">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>יכול מְמַשְּׁלָהּ מכל צד</he> you might think, he may use her in whatever way he pleases; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 32:3">Yalk. ib. 32</cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 36b:19">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>עבד … תַּמְשִׁילֵהוּ עלינו</he> a slave whom his master bought for twenty pieces of silver,—wilt thou make him a ruler over us?; a. e.
